label: D2 after a2->S2 common, previous trial unrewarded, mid-episode, weak a2 preference
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only after the agent chose a2 and reached S2 via the common transition (recall 1.0 for that condition, but precision 0.07). Of the activation mass, 96% comes when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward == 0). Two more gates lift precision: the policy logit at D2 is only weakly for a2 (choice > -3.5, never below about -4.4), and the episode position is trials 20-69 (no activity before trial 10 or after trial 80, which looks like an internal episode clock). This conjunction gives dev F1 0.65 and mass recall 0.94. Adding value > 7.6 changes F1 only marginally (0.655). It never fires at D1 or GO, after a1, on rare transitions, or when S1 is reached. Low-quartile activations are mostly the cases with prev_reward == 1. No future variables are used: action and state are observed at D2. Precision stays near 0.5, so some unidentified gating remains.
